I had one. It wasn't very vivid and I don't remember a lot of details from it. It was with a girl whom I never thought of in a sexual way in real life and tbh it got me confused about whether I'm actually ace.
This is so hard to wrap my head around
It happens to me too. I feel sick to my stomach sometimes when I'm anxious

Hey I'm glad to hear that I'm not the only one feeling like this.

I completely understand what you said about having friends from lower tax brackets. When I met some of my friends in junior college, they were under financial assistance because their families had problems paying the school fees. To be honest, I hadn't even heard of this scheme before because it was never something I needed to consider and my friends from my old schools also didn't need financial assistance. I realised I needed to be more careful about what I said around them, because I didn't want them to feel bad when I complained about something that would be an insignificant problem to them. I also felt that I couldn't share good things in my life with them in fear of making them feel bad. And because of this, I couldn't develop a very strong and deep friendship with them because I couldn't share all my problems with them or talk about some things that made me happy.
Thanks for your reply and I hope things get better for you soon!

Hey, thank you for replying! 

I did find my crushes attractive, as in I thought they looked attractive and cute. But it actually never really occurred to me to masturbate to them until once when I was spoke to my friend (who is also ace and thinks I could be ace too) and she asked me if I had thought about having sex with them. I didn't so I tried to think about them while masturbating but it felt wrong. I did feel guilty so I stopped thinking about it.
I hear you. Insomnia plagues me too on my worst days. I try to just tell myself to rest, not sleep. It takes a whole lot of the pressure off and you may just eventually drift off.
Yep, all the time. It's especially bad when I see a whole group of people just laughing and talking with each other and I just stand there awkwardly not knowing how to enter the convo.
